chapters.title: Chapter 651: Soul Path Awakening (2)
paragraphs: As for the Orbital Dominion, it has to do with how he can use these celestial bodies in combat. It turns out he can use them for both attacking and defending.
This tome taught him how to create shields around his planets and how to orbit and align them in a way that makes incoming attacks easy to defend against.

It is all technical, and even though Kent doesn’t have access to the seven tomes left, he knew there was a buildup to the Orbital Dominion. He knew it involved the laws, so he chose to create something and experiment first.

The Stellar Cataclysm is basically the combat aspect of the entire Soul Universe. Kent now possesses abilities like Solar Flare, which allows him to harness the power of the sun and shoot it like a laser.

Abilities like Nova Burst, where he can temporarily transform a summoned star into a nova, releasing an explosive burst of energy that can knock back and severely damage all enemies within a large radius.
That one is something Kent plans on using soon. It has so much potential to end an entire army within seconds.
The best part: the sun that he creates or the planets that he makes can grow endlessly, provided he has enough Soul Essence to keep fueling them.

Additionally, the outcome of how powerful his celestial bodies can be is determined by the strength of Kent’s soul. So, the higher he rises in soul cultivation, the stronger the Soul Universe becomes.

"Too bad I have to get to Tier 20 in soul cultivation before I can create black holes," Kent shook his head. He expected to be able to do something like that now, but it turns out his soul is still too weak for that.

"Though I could experiment and perhaps create something similar, after all, the tomes said nothing about me following a strict rule. This means I have free authority to create anything I want, so that is what I am going to do, I will create anything I want."
Kent stayed inside the cosmic space for a couple of months, learning the three tomes and the other things he could utilize from the first three tomes.
When he was done, he decided to go back to his body. Years had already passed, so he knew he had to take a rest before getting crazy with other things
"Aaaahhhh!"
Kent shouted and jumped back when he opened his eyes.
"You cheeky little devils, you scared me." Kent’s heartbeat rose and fell as he stared at the three lolis who were smiling at him, each covering their face with a hideous mask.
Their faces were a few inches away from Kent when he woke up, so despite him facing harrowing dangers already, they managed to scare the hell out of him—something anyone would have fallen for.
⟪Told you it would work⟫ Dori said, smiling at her master.
⟪You won this one, but next time, I will pick the prank, and I am sure Master will run off like a scared little child when he wakes up.⟫
Gaia bragged, the three of them smiling at their master, who was just looking at them with a calm yet flustered expression.
’They got me good this time.’ Kent couldn’t deny it. His cosmic lolis truly got him this time. The prank was perfect, unlike the last time he had to walk around with a painted face.
"You three, come here," Kent called out, but they wouldn’t wait to know what was about to happen. They bolted.
But Kent was fast. Since he is the master of the tower, he easily locked the Soul Tower, trapping them inside.

⟪Master, I know you already know this because you are from Earth, but punishing children who are just playing pranks is called child abuse. You better not have any funny ideas.⟫ Gaia said, looking somewhat happy that they got themselves in trouble.
In their minds, they were about to play with their master.
Kent looked at their expressions and knew that punishing them would make them happy. However, that didn’t stop him from punishing them.
In the end, they ran off to the Mountain Garden rubbing their bottoms. Kent smirked and decided to check his Soul Essence, currently in storage.
A smile appeared on his face when he saw the staggering numbers showing the amount of Soul Essence in storage.
⟦Soul Essence: 5,910,700,000⟧
"Almost four billion was added. I suppose having an entire race provide me with Soul Essence isn’t a bad thing at all. But is that even enough?"
"Gaia, dear, can you tell me how long it has been since I started awakening the Soul Path?" Kent asked because if what he was thinking turned out to be the reason, then he would be thrilled.
⟪It has been 21 years, Master, a very long time for a person to be asleep. A lot has happened that even I don’t know where to start from.
However, we managed to retrieve your servant. He is training in the dungeons. The rest, I will tell you when you are done.⟫
Kent nodded and then decided to get back inside the Soul Universe to see what he could do with the 5.9 billion Soul Essence at his disposal.
He soon found himself inside the cosmic space.

"What should I create first in my Universe?" Kent wondered, gazing out at the beautiful surroundings. "I can’t even start to think of creating a planet, considering that inside the tomes, the amount required to create something like that is just too much.
However, I can start something."
Kent pondered for a few more minutes and then decided to proceed with something. "I will just start with an asteroid."
Kent opened his palm and then started channeling his Soul Essence. The process was simple; since he knew what he wanted to make, he could just condense it in his palm and then plant it.
In other words, he would create a seed of the celestial body using a part of the Soul Essence. Then, later, with him having an abundance of Soul Essence, he could simply keep feeding it in.
So he started, and after what felt like a month, a small, perhaps atomic-sized asteroid formed in his palm.
"Finally." Kent smiled and then made the seed of the asteroid float away from his hand. Now, I just have to wait and see what will happen.
When he got back to the tower and checked his Soul Essence in reserve, his jaw dropped wide open.
⟦Soul Essence: 3,970,000,000⟧
"Well, isn’t that just great?" Kent smiled, watching his Soul Essence reserve dwindle by the second.
"Gaia, tell me what happened while I was asleep."

chapters.title: Chapter 652: Tower Full Of Monsters (1) [Bonus]
paragraphs: A lot happened while Kent was out working on his soul path all those years. First was the awakening of his ladies.
Before he entered the deep sleep, only Elsa, Neomi, Ingrid, Selene, Alina, Camilla, Vari, Lani, Nara, Elaine, and Lilian had awakened their Primordial spirits.

However, a few years after Elaine emerged from her Primordial Chamber, awakening the Life and Death Space, Mara also awakened her Primordial spirit and emerged from her Chamber with the most elegant space among her sisters who had already awakened their Primordial spirits.
"Angel Space."
That was the name of the Primordial World, and just as its name suggests, it is beautiful. Naturally, Mara’s true name originated from the Moonlit Angel race, so this means she is a Moonlit Angel.
Her Angel Space embodies all the best aspects of her, from the cosmic river to moon streams, gardens, floating islands, and many more.
Back when the true Angel race was still in this known universe, there were some beautiful butterflies called Angel Butterflies. She has most of those inside her Angel Space.
They don’t have much use now, but she can fly on their backs both inside her Angel Space and on the outside. That demonstrates their usefulness.
She joined her sisters on the stairs.
A month later, Val also came out with the same Space as Selene. The two rivals actually awakened the same space.

Of course, every Primordial Space/world is unique, so despite awakening the Lunar Space, Val’s own is different. For starters, her space is suspended in the clouds and has two half moons instead of the full moon in Selene’s own.
It was a sight to behold. Also, she awakened something similar to Nara’s Hell Flame Art. Her own is the Lunar Flame Art, meaning she had awakened the infamous Lunar Flame.
This made her someone to be feared. However, her awakening was overshadowed when Velyra came out with a rather powerful space.
"Blood Space."
Velyra awakened Blood Space, one that conveys its true meaning. Neomi’s Killing Space is dangerous, but Velyra’s Blood Space is terrifying.

Aside from the Blood Sea inside and the fact that the majority of the things are red, she awakened a Primordial Spirit who came out sitting at the Tier 18 stage with a perfect Harmony affinity for blood.
That was something none of her sisters saw coming, but she walked out with blood Qi oozing from her body, showing the red-skinned beauty was no longer just a follower of the Mother of Killers.
She had become a killer herself, and the arsenal at her disposal was just too much for someone to wield. She also awakened an Art of a kind.
"Blood Berserker Art."
Even after her Primordial Spirit regressed, she remains a formidable warrior who will wreak havoc on the battlefield.
After her, Princess Lovina also walked out. She awakened a rather sinister space that perfectly matches her wicked Poison Witch personality.
"Poison Space."

Her Primordial Space is rather dangerous. Everything inside the space is poisonous or can be turned into poison. In fact, she has one large cauldron inside her Poison Space that can be used to cook poison.
And since her True Name hasn’t been awakened yet, she wouldn’t be able to start following the Ancient Path like her sisters.
So her Tier 17 Primordial Spirit was hard at work, creating some of the most dangerous poisons there are.
In her defense, she believed that with the right poison, everything can be settled. It was a twisted way of thinking, yet being one of them now, the ladies just laughed.

However, they couldn’t deny the fact that Princess Lovina’s poison affinity was now on a different level. If she had awakened her Primordial Spirit before going for revenge, the battle would have ended in under ten minutes.
After she awakened her Primordial Spirit, three years passed before the next sister walked out. This time it was Vexthra, the goddess herself.
She walked out smiling because, finally, she knew her dream to fight beside her man had come true. She awakened a space that matches her divinity.
"Hateful & Resentful Space."
One interesting thing that happened when she awakened her space was that the other path, which is the Dao Path, was mastered by her, or more importantly, her Primordial Spirit mastered it.
She came out sitting on the 7th stage of Goodhood, the ’God Lord’ stage, showing that she had comprehended 1,000 Daos (Laws).
This means that at any moment, if she wanted, she could break through and become a Supreme. However, she had to take it slow and first handle the Ancient Path.
This meant she had to regress her Primordial Spirit to Tier 1.
This, of course, was what Vexthra was after. Though fighting with a Primordial Spirit is dangerous, she is a god; she can easily handle a bunch of mortals, even if she is at a lower Tier.
So, she regressed her Primordial Spirit to Tier 1, and that expanded her Primordial Space to several million miles in diameter.
It became so large that Vexthra felt her True God cultivation base strengthen even further. And the best part was that her Law of Hatred and Resentment continued to improve as well.
It was safe to say the Vexthra who came down from the god realm wouldn’t be returning the same anymore. She had become very powerful and happy.

After she was done, she decided to supervise her sisters as they climbed the stairs. Then, three years after Vexthra came out, Unity finally walked out of her Primordial Chamber, oozing the aura of love.
Cherry blossoms, like an angel of love, literally surrounded her. The air around her was subtle and filled with positive energy.
Her sisters stopped all they were doing because the moment Unity walked out, they all felt the need to surround her and feel the love oozing from her. It was like they were bewitched.
Even Vexthra was swept by the aura coming from her sister. As someone who harbored hatred, this was like an awakening of the love buried deep within her soul.
"Love Space."
That was the name of the space Unity awakened. A beautiful space filled with love. Everything there was made with love and for love.
However, while that was awesome, the most shocking part was her Primordial Spirits.
Yes, Unity awakened two Primordial Spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 653: Tower Full Of Monsters (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: Unity’s awakening was like a miracle. Of course, Zaila’s primordial spirit had already made them aware that Unity had two primordial spirits, but seeing them was just too incredible.
One has white hair, and the other has dark hair. However, they each look the same: a beautiful, mature version of Unity.
One uses the bow, and the other is a painter.
They don’t have a name yet since Unity’s true name hasn’t awakened. However, looking at them, it wouldn’t take a genius to know they are goddesses despite their current Ranks.
Vexthra, who is a goddess, recognized the aura of divinity around them, and that made her very happy.

They came out Tier 18, and since she had yet to awaken her true name, just like Princess Lovina, she had to hold on for now. Once her True Name is awakened, she can regress them to Tier 1, so they will start walking the Ancient Path.
This means inside the tower, excluding Vexthra, Unity is the strongest, even stronger than Kent if her primordial spirits were to aid her in combat.
The primordial spirit that uses the bow looks feisty, combat-ready, and much more extroverted than the painter, who is quieter and easy-going.
Unity and her sister decided to give them pseudonyms for now, until they remembered their names or received them after the True Name awakening.
They called the archer "Feisty" and the painter "Blossom."
Inside her love space is just too beautiful, so her sisters took a few weeks off to explore the place and have fun. They deserved that.
However, after spending a week there, they went back to work.
⟪They are now climbing the stairs. Every last one of them has already become a Sage body cultivator and has broken at least four limits: two on their bodies and two on their minds.
Big sister Zaila has broken six, and she has already climbed 1,196 steps. She is left with only four more to reach the fourth stage of the Golden Titan Stairway and attain Nirvana.⟫
Gaia smiled. Dori and Akira, who came with her, also smiled.
⟪I know I should be encouraging you now, Master, but I don’t think you can defeat them with your current strength.
They are monsters. You only find their kind in the Larger High Worlds, Immortal worlds, and Unique worlds.⟫
"Looks like I have myself a bunch of freaks..." Kent smiled happily.
His only fear was that his ladies would feel useless. However, that was no longer the case. They are capable of protecting him—something they all wanted to do for a long time now.
"It seems treasures from the Tower are just too precious," Kent said, and his three assistants nodded.
⟪They are now planning to visit the Realm Comprehension Space and see if they can comprehend their realms.
Each one of them has already seen where their path leads.

This means they can now form a path—the basics, of course—but they are ready. However, before that, they want to reach the 4th stage, which is the 1,200th step, first. And judging by their speed, they will accomplish that in a few years.⟫
Kent nodded. Hearing his wives were doing better than fine made him happy.
"What about the others... the legions... those living in the cities?"
⟪The legion is doing better than ever. Every last one of them has reached the peak of the Core Formation stage and is now tempering their minds and combat abilities.
The undead legion is the same. Even Big Brother Kaizo is at the peak now, and strangely, he has become the third strongest, only lacking behind Veydris and Irina.⟫
"Wait, what?" Kent was stupefied. He hadn’t checked any messages yet since they were not in red. If they were in red, he would have checked. But not checking now proved to be a shock to him.
"Kaizo, the same Kaizo that is being bullied left, right, and center by his brothers, is now the third strongest. How?" Kent asked, not believing his eyes.
Gaia, Akira, and Dori smiled, looking at the genuine shock on Kent’s face.
⟪You will learn everything later... However, it turns out that Big Brother Kaizo has a rare bloodline that has long gone extinct since the Primordial Era: the Brute Divine Angel Bloodline.
They were once a mysterious race that appeared during the Primordial Era, and after the great war, they vanished.
I am sure you will learn more about them soon, since during the Primordial Era, they were natural enemies of the Leviathans, and you share a history with them.⟫
Dori, who has access to Kent’s mind, knew what had to be said and what ought to be learned when the time was right, so she only quenched and then piqued Kent’s curiosity.
⟪Big Brother Kaizo is now a formidable warrior. Even Aetheris, the flame giant, lost against him. It was a close battle, but he lost⟫, Akira added.
⟪And we have created eight new undead. But, for some reason, they are stuck in some suspended animation state that even Akira couldn’t bring them out of.
But they are fine. When you are done here, you can awaken them. You will have to awaken the true name for all your legions, too.
Every last one of them has now reached the stage of awakening their true names.⟫
Kent nodded. "What about Yi Lai?" The hunter sent after him by hand is now his servant, so he wanted to know.
⟪She still hasn’t awakened yet. However, signs around the cocoon show it wouldn’t be long now.⟫
Kent nodded again and smiled. "She’d better surprise me when she is done with her awakening.
"And Jacob, what happened to him?"
⟪He was at the peak of the Root Ascendant stage when we brought him.

But years have passed inside the tower, so he has reached the peak of the Sovereign stage, and thanks to his many brothers and sisters, who keep bullying — I mean, training him every day, he can kill even a Peak Core Formation expert and hold his own against a Spirit Ascendant.

But as someone who holds the legacy of Krex Nithal, the undying Cockroach, not even a Spirit King can kill him. Somehow, he always seems to find himself in difficult situations but walks out unscathed every time.⟫
Kent smirked.

Big sister Zaila has broken six, and she has already climbed 1,196 steps.
She is left with only four more to reach the fourth stage of the Golden Titan Stairway and attain Nirvana.⟫
Gaia smiled.
Dori and Akira, who came with her, also smiled.
⟪I know I should be encouraging you now, Master, but I don’t think you can defeat them with your current strength.
They are monsters.
You only find their kind in the Larger High Worlds, Immortal worlds, and Unique worlds.⟫
"Looks like I have myself a bunch of freaks..." Kent smiled happily.
His only fear was that his ladies would feel useless.
However, that was no longer the case.
They are capable of protecting him—something they all wanted to do for a long time now.
"It seems treasures from the Tower are just too precious," Kent said, and his three assistants nodded.
⟪They are now planning to visit the Realm Comprehension Space and see if they can comprehend their realms.
Each one of them has already seen where their path leads.
This means they can now form a path—the basics, of course—but they are ready.
However, before that, they want to reach the 4th stage, which is the 1,200th step, first.
And judging by their speed, they will accomplish that in a few years.⟫
Kent nodded.
Hearing his wives were doing better than fine made him happy.
"What about the others... the legions... those living in the cities?"
⟪The legion is doing better than ever.
Every last one of them has reached the peak of the Core Formation stage and is now tempering their minds and combat abilities.
The undead legion is the same.
Even Big Brother Kaizo is at the peak now, and strangely, he has become the third strongest, only lacking behind Veydris and Irina.⟫
"Wait, what?" Kent was stupefied.
He hadn’t checked any messages yet since they were not in red.
If they were in red, he would have checked.
But not checking now proved to be a shock to him.
"Kaizo, the same Kaizo that is being bullied left, right, and center by his brothers, is now the third strongest.
How?" Kent asked, not believing his eyes.
Gaia, Akira, and Dori smiled, looking at the genuine shock on Kent’s face.
⟪You will learn everything later...
However, it turns out that Big Brother Kaizo has a rare bloodline that has long gone extinct since the Primordial Era: the Brute Divine Angel Bloodline.
They were once a mysterious race that appeared during the Primordial Era, and after the great war, they vanished.
I am sure you will learn more about them soon, since during the Primordial Era, they were natural enemies of the Leviathans, and you share a history with them.⟫
Dori, who has access to Kent’s mind, knew what had to be said and what ought to be learned when the time was right, so she only quenched and then piqued Kent’s curiosity.
⟪Big Brother Kaizo is now a formidable warrior.
Even Aetheris, the flame giant, lost against him.
It was a close battle, but he lost⟫, Akira added.
⟪And we have created eight new undead.
But, for some reason, they are stuck in some suspended animation state that even Akira couldn’t bring them out of.
But they are fine.
When you are done here, you can awaken them.
You will have to awaken the true name for all your legions, too.
Every last one of them has now reached the stage of awakening their true names.⟫
Kent nodded.
"What about Yi Lai?" The hunter sent after him by hand is now his servant, so he wanted to know.
⟪She still hasn’t awakened yet.
However, signs around the cocoon show it wouldn’t be long now.⟫
Kent nodded again and smiled.
"She’d better surprise me when she is done with her awakening.
"And Jacob, what happened to him?"
⟪He was at the peak of the Root Ascendant stage when we brought him.

But years have passed inside the tower, so he has reached the peak of the Sovereign stage, and thanks to his many brothers and sisters, who keep bullying — I mean, training him every day, he can kill even a Peak Core Formation expert and hold his own against a Spirit Ascendant.
But as someone who holds the legacy of Krex Nithal, the undying Cockroach, not even a Spirit King can kill him.
Somehow, he always seems to find himself in difficult situations but walks out unscathed every time.⟫
Kent smirked.

chapters.title: Chapter 654: The Alchemy Path [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So it has been 47 years since I entered seclusion, and everyone has turned into a freak." Kent laughed, shaking his head.

⟪I already told you the day you awakened the tower that it is something beyond this universe. Anyone affiliated with it is destined to rise and become someone worthy of respect.⟫ Gaia said with a subtle pride oozing...
But she wasn’t wrong. Every single person linked to the tower seems to be growing faster than they would have otherwise.
The humans inside the tower are already reaching the peak of the Core Formation stage, with the weakest being at the Transcendent stage.
On the outside, even a Transcendent is worthy of respect. It demonstrates the tower’s effectiveness and highlights its benefits for Kent.
The stronger they become, the more Points and spiritual qi they can give Kent. He has already reached the Level 7 Sovereign stage.
Although this may seem slow, as someone with such a powerful bloodline and having maximized twice, He needs some time to rise. But even with that, he had reached Level 7.
⟪As for the Bloodvein tribe, I’m at a loss for words. The tribe chief, the three elders, and the army general are all at the peak, and each has perfect affinity for Chaos energy.
The moment you rise to a higher world, the tower will upgrade. Once that happens, the Chaos Pool will become much more vitalized, allowing them to rise higher.⟫
Kent smiled. "This all sounds good."
⟪One last thing. Shax, that demon you let go, sent a message. He said that in five months, a chance to enter the Supreme Immortal Sect will appear, so you should make yourself known before then.
He said you can come to the Half-Elf Kingdom; they are much more welcoming to humans.
You have less than ten years inside the tower, so you might want to hurry.⟫

Kent nodded and then stood up. "I need less than a year to catch up to the Pill Princess." His arrogance was spoken out of confidence. With his soul strength, even a Pill Emperor would bow before him.
"I will be inside the Alchemy Tower. Let me know if you need anything or if something urgent comes up." Kent vanished and appeared directly inside the Pill Room.
He waved his hand, and hundreds of ingredients fell on a large table.

"If not for the requirements, I would have ignored the Tier 5 pills and gone straight to Tier 6. But at last, as an alchemist, I must follow the stages regardless of how easy they are." Kent sighed and then pulled a scroll from the tower space, spreading it open.
"I need to concoct ten Tier 5 pills and one each for Tier 6 and 7. Then gain two enlightenments in the pill path. However, my opponent has completed five enlightenments and she is even a Pill Saint.
This means she is superior to me in every way. However, I know a way to gain enlightenment easily..." Kent smiled.
"Getting the first three won’t be an issue." He picked the pills he would concoct and then decided to get to work.

Of course, the reason he was confident he would gain enlightenment was because the Pill Dao favored him—no, it was because of his second pill flame, ’Purifying Flame,’ and the purifying technique he had inherited from the pill records.
"First off, Foundation Building Pill," Kent picked the classic first. "I will try Tier 4 first."
Twenty minutes later, a smile appeared on his lips.
⟦You have successfully concocted a Foundation Building Pill. Grade: Tier 4, Quality: Perfect. Purity: 100%.⟧

"Easy enough. Then why don’t I try Tier 5?" Since he was rich, he bought the herbs in abundance, knowing he would need them all. Ordinary alchemists wouldn’t have been able to afford such wealth, but Kent is loaded.
Thirty minutes later, he retrieved the pill with a smile playing on his lips.
⟦You have successfully concocted a Foundation Building Pill. Grade: Tier 5, Quality: Perfect. Purity: 100%.⟧
"Looks like I am much more impressive and rather fast and efficient after my soul cultivation reached Tier 13."
He scratched the back of his neck and sighed.
"Now starts the real thing. The records covered up to Tier 7, but with the knowledge I have, I can easily do that. However, Tier 8 will be a headache.
I need to get there quickly because, to gain enlightenment easily, you have to try something beyond your current abilities.
This means using Tier 7 skills to concoct Tier 8 pills is impossible, and as such, I should gain my enlightenment."
He quickly started the Tier 6 pill concoction. Forty-five minutes later, the message appeared, and of course, it was 100% pure. Another message appeared after that.
⟦You have successfully concocted a Foundation Building Pill. Grade: Tier 6, Quality: Perfect. Purity: 100%.⟧
⟦You have met one of the requirements to become a Pill Saint.⟧
"Good. Then Tier 7, then."
An hour later, Kent smiled yet again, seeing the messages.
⟦You have successfully concocted a Foundation Building Pill. Grade: Tier 7, Quality: Perfect. Purity: 100%.⟧
⟦You have met one of the requirements to become a Pill Saint.⟧
These messages served as a reminder that he had already reached a stage in alchemy that he never expected.
Of course, in a way, it can be considered a cheat, but as someone who has the knowledge embedded in his mind, all these are just simple processes for him.
Thanks to his ladies, his mind has now become much more powerful, allowing him to comprehend complex processes.
His mind has become much more robust than one could imagine.
If he possesses the knowledge—specifically the refining techniques for Tier 12 pills—combined with his soul strength, he can easily accomplish it.
The only thing holding him back is the requirement to become a Pill Saint, but his talent far surpasses that of a Pill King. His potential is endless.

"Time to start Tier 8. I have ten years to make my presence known on the other continent. By then, I must reach the level that this Pill Princess will beg me to become her master," Kent burst out laughing.
A few minutes after he had calmed down, he got to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: Flame Tower Opening
paragraphs: Aside from the Human continent, there are the Dragon, Elf, Dwarf, Beastkin, and Demons continents. The Elves used to be three kingdoms: the High Elves, the Normal Elves, and the Half Elves.
However, years ago, the Half Elves and the Normal Elves banded together and eradicated the High Elves. Of course, most of the High Elves fled to the High Worlds using Ascension platforms.
They were the royals of the Elven race, so they had the means to ascend easily despite the cost involved.

It was a great undertaking on the part of the Elves and the Half Elves. However, after the High Elves were taken care of, the alliance between the Elves and the Half Elves started to fracture. It was a sign that the Elves were now doing the same thing the High Elves did.
And since, naturally, the Elves had a stronger elven lineage than the Half-Elves, the Half-Elves succumbed and became inferior to the Elves.

The devils they went to bed with are now their demons, and for years now, they have been suppressed. Every generation, they rank last because the talents and everything else come from the Elves. Now, they are at a crossroads that can make or break them.

The Half Elves and the Elves live on the eastern side of the Black Sea. They share an undivided boundary within the Demons, just like how the Dragons and the Beastkin are, in the South, and the Dwarves in the North.
At the moment, inside a large hall, a slender Elven man with pointed ears sat on a throne, gazing at the ten figures seated to his left and right.
This is King Thalirion, the highest authority of the Half Elves, and from the look on his face, it was plain as day he wasn’t happy.
"She has gone too far this time," King Thalirion said, hitting the arm of his throne. The ten elders inside the hall also clenched their fists.

"We used to get ten slots whenever the Flame Tower opened; that was how we managed to send five of our own to the Supreme Immortal Sect. Now she is giving us only five while her side gets twenty-five. That is just not fair."
Lord Faelar, a tall and lean man with silver hair and sharp gray eyes, said, the pain in his eyes evident.
The Flame Tower is an artifact left behind 25,000 years ago after the Battle of Parting. It is said to contain some of the most powerful Flame Arts.
Every ten years, it opens to a select few for entry. Every Kingdom except the human continent gets thirty slots.

The Elves, who are the leaders of the Elven empire, give ten slots to the Half Elves and keep thirty for themselves. However, today, the half-Elves just received a report that they will be given only five this year.
That was a plain insult from the Elf Queen. Doing so will deprive them of the chance to send their young geniuses to the most prestigious sect in the entire world, the Supreme Immortal Sect.

They say the sect is in a pocket dimension somewhere outside of Sonox, and it is extremely wealthy. Every year, depending on the number of geniuses you have in the sect, the kingdom will receive resources from them.
The Half Elves had sent five geniuses in since the requirement was established, which is to comprehend three levels of the Flame Art they had chosen.
Those who manage to do so will have the opportunity to take the sect exams and, if passed, become disciples within the sect.
They usually get ten slots while the Elves have thirty. However, they have now reduced their slots to five.
"What should we do?" Lord Theren, a dark-haired, weathered-faced man, asked, looking at King Thalirion. They could challenge the Elves. However, they just couldn’t.
The Elf Queen, or as they call her, the Bitch Queen, is unreasonable and, as someone with a hot temper, can easily take back the five slots they gave them.
So their hands are tied.
"We have already selected ten plausible candidates this year, but as it stands, five won’t be going. We have to do something.
Getting even a chance to take the sect exams is something worth celebrating, and that can only happen if all ten geniuses we have chosen get an opportunity to enter the Flame Tower."
Lord Theren spoke again.

The other lords in the hall nodded. "Maybe we can try buying five more from the Demons. Every demon state has fifteen slots, totaling 105 slots in all. I am sure they can consider our plight and help us."
"They won’t. I learned this time around that more geniuses have emerged in the Demon Empire. We can’t get what we want unless we give them what they want," Lord Vire said, shaking his head.
"Those honey bastards..." Naturally, they were talking about the Incubus. The Demon King of the Incubus state wanted to marry one of the princesses of the Half-Elf race.
Granted, the Half Elves are willing; getting five more slots would be an easy feat. However, a genius such as Princess Aeryn wouldn’t want to become a plaything for such a honey bastard.
So they wouldn’t accept their offer, which in this case means the Half Elves are left with their five slots, and there is nothing they can do to change that.
The Dragons won’t mind them, and neither would the Beastkin or the Dwarves. So they can only make do with what they have now.
All ten lords looked at King Thalirion, who seemed to have figured something out.
"It is unfortunate we only have five slots. However, while that is unfortunate, we can only make the best of the hand we were dealt, so let’s make an announcement.

Three months from today, there will be an open competition purely on flame manipulation. The top five will get a slot to enter the Flame Tower and some other rewards that will be announced on the day of the competition," King Thalirion paused and sighed.
"This challenge includes the ten already selected."
The elders were hesitant, but upon reflection, it was the only way for them to select the best out of the hundreds that would compete.
In a way, they’re betting everything on the best of their kin, regardless of the person’s background.

chapters.title: Chapter 656: Chaos Flame, Leaving Seclusion
paragraphs: Just like that, fifty years had passed inside the tower since Kent entered Selcusion. On the outside, two years and a month had passed. Not too long, but quite a long time for people living inside the tower.
Not that they cared. Their ages advanced based on the time outside, so despite fifty years passing, they were all only two years and a month older.
Kent, who had entered the Alchemy Tower to advance his understanding of the Alchemy path, sat silently, a deep golden flame burning on his forehead.

It had already been a year since he reached his fourth enlightenment. The plan was to gain only three enlightenments. However, Kent was swept away when he started enjoying pill making every time he emerged from an enlightenment.

The first enlightenment was on purification. He got to witness a true Pill Emperor purify pills. It was a mesmerizing display that left him in awe. This made him fall in love with Alchemy all over again.
So he became obsessed and started working hard on the purification process of pill making. Every step in alchemy is important. Not even a single step can be ignored.
However, the Purification stage is the point where the medicinal value of the pill is determined.
Without a good understanding of purification, a pill may appear 100% perfect, but its quality will pale in comparison to one made by someone with a good purification technique.
But it wasn’t just about making a pill more powerful in terms of medicinal value... The Pill Purification stage can also raise the grade of a pill.

Most alchemists, like Kent, use ingredients that match the grade of the pill they want to concoct. Tier 3 ingredients will be used to create Tier 3 pills, and Tier 4 ingredients will be used to develop Tier 4 pills.
However, what Kent was after was taking Tier 3 ingredients to concoct Tier 4 pills; it was, in fact, not an easy task, since the purification process had to be very thorough.
Of course, Kent suspected someone like the Pill Princess would have the prowess to do something like that, so he focused on that.

Kent wanted to advance his understanding of that, so for two months he tried, never stopping despite the failures he encountered along the way... until he succeeded and entered his second enlightenment.

This time, when he emerged, his focus shifted to something else. It appeared that to achieve what he was after, his understanding of flame control and manipulation must be at the ’High’ or ’Very High’ stage.
Even with that, he would only be able to go as far as Tier 8 pills. This meant he could use Tier 7 ingredients to concoct Tier 8 pills.
He became obsessed, and before he knew it, several months passed. Then his enlightenment came when he demonstrated great understanding of flame manipulation.
Yet again, after the third enlightenment, another roadblock arose, this time involving his soul flame. Understanding pill making is good, but having good flames is the best part.

Alchemy mainly depended on the strength of one’s soul...So it wasn’t surprising that he needed a soul flame. He was even planning on chasing after that one of these days. But now, he knew he must get it done before meeting the Pill Princess.
So far, the flames Kent was using were all Legendary grade. Good, but not the best. They couldn’t even help him concoct a Tier 9 pill.
After consulting the tower, he found out that to rise to the top, he must awaken his soul flame. He can use the external pill flames. However, soul flame is the best.
A soul flame is a spirit-grade flame that has no equal. Of course, it was estimated that every time a soul flame awakens, it can be regarded as a Rare flame.
However, it can be nourished with other flames.
This discovery made Kent even more determined to awaken his soul flame. So he began, and a few weeks later, he entered enlightenment, but had yet to emerge.
Thankfully, a few days ago, a deep golden flame appeared on his forehead, indicating that he had awakened his soul flame.
Two days later, Kent opened his eyes, a smile on his lips as a flame burned before him. It was subtle and quiet; however, the energy inside couldn’t be underestimated.

chapters.title: Chapter 668: The Bitch Queen
paragraphs: Sylveria is the name of the Elven Kingdom. It is a beautiful kingdom, one where life is good. It isn’t too much to say it is one of the most beautiful kingdoms in the world.
The natural settings surrounding their kingdom made the elves even prouder and, well, arrogant. It is even said that just stepping into the borders of the Elven Kingdom can heal all kinds of fatigue.
It is a nice place and very prosperous.
There are three cities inside the Elven Kingdom, and the queen of the elves is located in Moonglade City.
Her palace is situated on a mountain, and judging by how much craftsmanship went into building such a palace, it holds great importance to the elves.
Inside the palace, the Queen of the elves, a silver-haired beauty who can rival immortals, sat on an elegant throne made out of the rarest woods and stones.
Its beauty alone made the queen shine even more.
Away from the throne, five people were seated—three on her left and two on the right.

"My queen, what do you suppose we do? It seems that giving the five slots still hasn’t triggered the half-breeds to bend the knee to us. I think they still haven’t learned their lesson," one of the elven Lords spoke in a tone dripping with arrogance.

"What Lord Arlen said is indeed true, my lady. They even declared an open competition, allowing every last one of their people to compete, and the top five would have a chance to enter the Flame Tower.

They still believe they have a shot at sending yet again one of their kin to the Supreme Immortal Sect," Lord Folwin, one of the most disliked elven lords in the world, spoke, and as one would expect, the four with him nodded.
Queen Elenara just sat there saying nothing. Of course, the only reason she could sit and say nothing was that she also shared their way if thinking.
She wasn’t called the Bitch Queen for no reason. The half-elves hate her, and deep down, she knew she was arrogant and a very sinister person. But who can stop her?
Someone who can go head to head against someone like the Crystal Dragon Emperor or Lord Qilin of the Beastkin... she isn’t an easy target.

"My Queen, I believe you should address this swiftly and show these half-breeds they can never rise to our level... not when we have the Pill Princess on our side," Lord Folwin said, and the other lords nodded.

"Indeed, my Queen... It’s time we show them who’s in charge. They may have some aspect of our blood, but they are half-breeds, nothing compared to us...If anything, they are like the humans who are forgotten by the world."
Queen Elenara studied everyone’s expression, and then a sigh escaped her lips. "Just pick five of our best and send them to participate in the competition.

Since it is an open competition and we cannot reclaim the slot we gave them, the best we can do is win it back fairly. I am sure the few who couldn’t get to be part of the 25 we initially selected will be glad to have this chance."

The elven lords who knew how manipulative their queen was smiled when they heard her words. It was indeed true that they couldn’t take back the slot they had given to the half-Elves... so why not send their best to take it back fairly?

After all, since this is an open competition where anyone could participate, they really shouldn’t even have to think too much about it. It’s a brilliant idea to get what they want without making it look like they are taking back the slots.
A smart move on their part.
"Now that we have a solution, there is another issue, my Queen," Lord Arlen said, looking at Queen Elenara with reverent expression.
"Speak..."
"It is about that human named Kent. Since the Hand gave the notice, our spies in the human continent haven’t seen or heard from him again. It has already been two years, but nobody has spotted him.

However, that’s not all. It turns out the demons faced an issue recently, and it is related to the human named Kent. This shows he is on the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. But we are yet to locate him."
"Also, it turns out we aren’t the only ones looking for him, but we have to be the first to reach him and retrieve the Divine Atomic Body."
The Elven Queen nodded. "We truly have to get to him first before the others do. The fact that the Sea Race is showing interest in him means we cannot allow him to be captured by the others.
Kill him on sight when you see him, but if you can kidnap him too, that will be good." The five lords nodded.
"Remember, we are after the Divine Atomic Body. Under no circumstances should we fail." The lords nodded. Then, after a few back-and-forths, they left, leaving Queen Elenara to herself.
Several minutes after the lords left, a hidden doorway opened, and another beautiful lady with silver hair, identical to Queen Elenara’s, walked out. She looked older than Queen Elenara.
However, while she was probably thousands of years old, she didn’t appear a day older than thirty.
Of course, she was the ancestor of the Elven race, a being who participated in the Ancient Battle of Parting... someone who fought and killed hundreds of High Elves several years ago.
Looking at her posture and calm aura, it was plain that someone like her could easily handle the Dragon King with a flick of her finger.
She was once known as Queen Aelith... Now, she only cultivates and strengthens her foundations.

"Mother, you are out." Queen Elenara stood up and made the throne available for her mother. However, she waved her hand and sat in one of the chairs where the lords had been seated a couple of minutes ago.
"You are the queen now, Elenara, so don’t give away your throne just like that," Lady Aelith said, sitting casually in her chair.
Queen Elenara smiled. "Mother, why are you out... is everything alright?"
"Everything is alright. I just wanted to get some fresh air after spending hundreds of years in seclusion. Tell me, what is going on... have you succeeded in subjugating the half-breeds?"
"No, mother, but they will soon be bending the knee. I give it a few months. However, there is something else you must know.
Recently, the Hand spread news that a human by the name of Kent Madson owns a Divine Atomic Body..."
Lady Aelith raised her brow, then a crooked smile appeared on her lips. "Looks like I came out at the right time..."

chapters.title: Chapter 669: Awakening of the Dragon Necromancer
paragraphs: Kent spent several hours talking to his wives, ensuring he understood what was happening in their cultivation paths and what he could do to help them.
However, after hours, he found out Vexthra took care of all their needs, so all he could do was reward her with sex, which he did.
During the process of sharing this gift with her sisters, too, the tower informed Kent that something was happening in the Legion Tower.
So he had to leave.
The moment he appeared inside the Legion Tower, he was met with a quaking environment and a dense atmosphere filled with a terrifying necrotic aura.

Kent’s attention was drawn to the black cocoon that had been standing there for several years. Inside was the Hunter—the very hunter sent to kill Kent, but then she ended up losing her undead abominations.
Good enough for her, Kent picked her as his servant through the direction of the tower. Kent even gave her a gift the moment she became his servant.

Ever since then, she had been in a comatose state. However, it seems that she is now awakening, and the aura emanating from her suggests that she is developing into a powerful necromancer with great potential.
One would wonder why that was possible...

Naturally, she spent 50 years inside the cocoon, but in reality, she spent 50,000 years. When the cocoon formed, she entered a different state, like some trial where she was a swordsman just like Kent, and she, in one way or another, became his servant.
However, the moment she became Kent’s servant, her trust level was at 2%. It was a realm where it felt real, and for her to come out of it, she had to raise her trust level to 80%.
It took her 50,000 years.
She could have come out sooner, but she struggled to trust Kent to the extent that they had progressed from mortal stages to immortality before she managed to raise her trust level to 80%.

The moment she did, she woke up inside the cocoon, and that was when the gift Kent had given her took effect. Now, she is awakening a new life, almost like a rebirth, and the phenomenon happening shows that she is coming out powerful.

Kent watched as the cocoon slowly cracked and then gradually fell apart. When the last piece of the cocoon fell away, a figure could be seen seated in a lotus posture, dark lightning snaking around her arms.
She had long, dark hair and a cracked mask on her face, which quickly dissolved, revealing her pale face. She bore a tattoo of a skull on her forehead and a dark, bone-like Septer resting on her lap.
Looking at the beautiful lady clad in elegant yet tattered fabric, Kent couldn’t help but smile. He could see it—the hunter had become someone like him.
"She is now a dragon, a forbidden type of dragon... one of the ancient ones, the Abyssal Dragon." Kent smiled, happy for the Hunter.
However, his happiness wasn’t all for Hunter; he was glad one of Chaos’s dreams was fulfilled.
The Primal Bone Tempering Art he received from Leviathan back when he went to the Primal Chaos to train came from the Abyssal Dragon, the mother of the Abyssal Leviathans.

However, as far as he was concerned, the Abyssal Dragon had died several years before Chaos came into existence, so this was all too good for Kent, who was seeing someone of legend, even during the primordial era.

During the primordial era, they used to say, "Two were made. One was the Abyss, and the other was Chaos." Of course, Chaos was much more terrifying than the Abyss, but it was the darkness that paved the way for Chaos to dominate.
Without the Primal Bone Tempering Art, Chaos would have been set back several years. Perhaps he wouldn’t have even risen to prominence.
Seeing one of his subordinates awaken the bloodline of such a terrifying dragon, he couldn’t help but be happy.
ROAR.
Suddenly, a powerful roar came from the Hunter’s direction. Behind her stood a terrifying red dragon. Two majestic horns were mounted on its head, and its enormous wings spread several meters wide.
With just a glance, Kent knew that the dragon was undead and that its true cultivation base had already entered the Immortal stage. It was just that it had been suppressed to Peak Core Formation.
Hunter opened her eyes and locked gazes with Kent. It took a couple of minutes, but eventually, she smiled, signaling to Kent that it was time to approach her.
When he got close, the red dragon roared again. However, Kent smirked and activated his dragon eyes, causing his purple eyes to turn golden.
The red dragon folded its wings when it saw this.
"Good boy..." Kent laughed and looked at Hunter.
"So, how should we call you... Hunter or Yi Lai?"
"I prefer Yi Lai. That is my real name, and now that I am a new person, I wouldn’t want to go back to my old life again," Yi Lai said, standing up.
Kent nodded and then turned to his legion. "Gather around, everyone."
They all appeared around him in under a second. The red dragon standing behind Yi Lai stared at Zharkaz, the other dragon in the tower, then folded his wings further, assuming his human form.
However, unlike Kent’s human form, the red dragon’s transformation still retained his horns and a few dragon scales on his arms and forehead.
Though that only made him appear handsome and deadly. Kent knew something profound had happened to Yi Lai to come out with such a dragon, but for now, he just wanted to introduce everyone.
"Everyone, this is Yi Lai, the new addition to the legion and your new sister." The legion smiled, showing their welcoming faces.
Kent then introduced everyone. When he was done, they moved away to a more suitable place and sat down.
Though this was Yi Lai’s moment, Kent wanted to use the time to do something even more important: awaken their true names.
It took some time, but he managed to invoke their true names, causing great changes to happen.

If initially they were all monstrous beasts that could devour thousands of mountains of lava, incinerating anything in their path, then, after their true name awakening, they became more relatable and humanoid like Ankaara—something they all wanted.

Kent’s attention was drawn to the black cocoon that had been standing there for several years.

When the cocoon formed, she entered a different state, like some trial where she was a swordsman just like Kent, and she, in one way or another, became his servant.

chapters.title: Chapter 670: Memory Fragments (1) [Bonus]
paragraphs: Many changes occurred when Kent invoked the True Names of his Legion.

First, he finally received the legendary name for the dungeon boss, which is "Eternal Wrath Legion." He had already suspected this because Vexthra had told him the story of the Night Riders, which ultimately led to the legend of the Chaos Dragon.
But it wasn’t until then that he heard the name of his fourth legion.
In this instance, he could call them his third legion, considering he had yet to officially invoke the True Name of any of the Soul Sentinels, which excludes Elsa.
However, from what he knew, the Undead, the Lost Knights, the Soul Sentinels, and the Eternal Wrath were part of the legions that came from the future to defend the past.
And now that he had the official name for yet another legion, Kent became happy. However, there was something else that happened that made him happy to some extent.
When he first met the Eternal Wrath Legion, he found out they didn’t have their memories—well, not all of them. Ankaara, the ice elemental, had her memories intact, so that was a plus.
The 11 left; some had bits, but nothing concrete to tell where they came from and what led to them becoming dungeon bosses.
But now they started to remember—bits and fragments—but they started to recall their memories.
Skoggr, the Orc Chieftain, recalled his life as the chief of the Bloodmourn Orc Clan, located in the Yin-Yang Planetary Alliance, somewhere in the immortal worlds.
He didn’t gain much from the pieces he recalled, but the fragments revealed something he must know about himself: that he was a powerful warrior and a father.
Remembering he had children and was happily married made him tear up. Kent could see the pain in his eyes as he recalled those memories.
However, there wasn’t much they could do now, and considering he didn’t know what had happened that led him to become the last floor boss of a dungeon, they could only wait for more to be revealed.

Of course, they all began to sense that their disappearance and reappearance in the dungeons was starting to look like a betrayal. This was cemented when Khaazal, the wyvern, revealed what he had remembered.
It turned out he was indeed a guardian of the Tempest Peak; however, he discovered a conspiracy that would put the Wyvern race in danger, and so he reported it.

He was fuzzy on the details, but he knew it was severe enough to report to his leaders... and the last thing he remembered was falling into the Demon Cave...then he found himself on the top floor of the dungeon.
He remembered just a couple of details, but he was already happy. With time, he will likely regain more of his memories. Naturally, this was the case for most of them.
Nykali, the Shade King, also remembered that he was a cult leader of "The Forbidden Nightmares." One of the many powerful Soulmancy cults in the universe.
He also recalled that he was only a few modifications away from creating the first-ever Soul Weapon capable of killing a Celestial.
However, the last thing he remembered was that he was accused of taking the soul of a Dragon Ancestor, and that led to many things he had yet to recall...
But one thing was sure: the Shade King was pissed.
However, he knew when to throw a tantrum... now was not that time. But that doesn’t mean he wasn’t pissed...

Still, it revealed some critical details that he could exploit, and those were "Soul Weaving." He was not a soul weaver, but he had the means to weave complex spectrals and weapons from the souls of the fallen.
It wasn’t just an overpowered skill; it was the type of skill that went much deeper than one might think. Now, he knew how to utilize his weaving skills much more effectively.

It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say he felt like he was betrayed. The memory showed that he was someone impressive, but at the end of the day, he was left with many questions that would be answered as more memories surfaced.
But he gained something valuable, and that was a profound understanding of ’Soul Weaving’...

Now, when it came to weaving, his years of experience had skyrocketed, and soon he would start making moves to strengthen his spectral army, because after recalling bits of his memory, he recognized how pitiful his army truly was.

Aetheris only recalled that he was the guardian of the Flame Keep, the sanctuary of the Fallen body from which he was made. He remembered the Flame Keep had five guardians, and he was the weakest but also the hardest working.
As to how he ended up on the last floor of a dungeon, he didn’t have that memory yet... but just like his pals, he also seemed pissed.
He didn’t have the memory, but his instincts kept telling him his absence was a disaster he had tried for years to prevent.
As for Ka’zarak, the Savage Warden, his memories were of his battle with a Dark Wolf he wanted to bring into his fold.
Ka’zarak is a beast tamer and summoner, but with an unconventional method of taming. For him, instead of summoning the beasts, he was the one being summoned, and he had to battle them.

If he defeated them, the beasts would become his loyal contracted beasts; otherwise, he would come back empty-handed. Even if he died during the fight, he would respawn outside the realm he was sent to.
Naturally, the true cultivation of the beast he fought would be adjusted to match him, so all the battles were fair on both fronts.
His memories were from when he had just become an Immortal, and the Dark Wolf, Klopk, summoned him. It was his first time being summoned by a beast several realms above him.
Klopk is a demigod beast, one of the most dangerous beasts in the 14 Heavenly Beast Worlds. Their battle ended in a draw, and Klopk chose to become his companion to his shock.

He didn’t understand why someone like Klopk would want to become his companion, but he had spent 12 good days in combat with a suppressed demigod and had held his own against him. That was a happy memory for him, and to his shock, he received his first true contracted beast.
He even summoned Klopk, and looking at the Dark Wolf Man who appeared with two short swords sheathed on his back, it wasn’t hard to know the strongest among them had appeared.
Even Kent felt the danger deep within his bones. But he was happy for Ka’zarak...

Unlike his peers, who received sad memories by far, his was a good one, and the reward in return was good. But there was one thing: Klopk knew what had happened, but for some reason, he couldn’t talk about it.
However, he knew, and that alone explained a lot.

And for some reason, Kent has a nagging feeling that these lost memories of his Eternal Wrath had something to do with him, or more like the incarnation of him that had formed the Eternal Wrath legion.
But since he can’t do anything about it now, things could wait. The Truth will one day reveal itself...soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: Memory Fragments (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: As for Veera, the necromancer in the team, she was a member of a necromancy cult known in the universe as the Odyssey.
She didn’t recall her rank, whether she was high-ranking or just a normal member, but she knew the Odyssey was a group she had wanted to join from the day she became a necromancer.
She also recalled entering a fragment of the great battlefield—the battlefield of the Great War, the one that happened during the Primordial Era.
She remembered meeting her first human undead there, since, to her shock, she couldn’t raise any dead spirits there. It was like some laws suppressed her from doing that.
However, the spirit she met became her first trump card, which she used to gain access to even more battlefields.
Her necromancy is the grave-robbing kind. However, she also has a class ability that allows her to merge multiple undead to form more powerful ones.
This skill works on both humans and beasts, and now that her memories have started to surface, the skill is available to her to use.
As for how she found herself on the last floor of the dungeon, she had a vague idea.
It was a friend who joined another organization that was at odds with the Odyssey. It felt like a knife plunged through her heart when she recalled that memory.
But since she didn’t know for sure, she could only speculate that perhaps things weren’t as simple as they appeared.

As for Gorzak, the Barbarian King, he outright knew how he ended up on the last floor of the dungeon—it was because his wife had conspired with the enemy. During his tribulation to become an Immortal King, he was attacked.
Those tribulations are dangerous, so immortals tend to seek the most secure place they can find. Most pass out after their tribulation.
It takes a great deal to overcome such tribulation. Most become weakened, and in Gorzak’s case, he was attacked in his weakened state.
The last thing he remembered was falling into the abyss...
It wasn’t hard to see Gorzak’s desire for revenge, and Kent promised him that. It was also one of the reasons Kent made up his mind to start showing his true strength soon.
The only reason he wouldn’t ascend now was because of the Hand, but that doesn’t mean he would have to remain hidden...
From what he knew, the moment the first Apocalypse Key was found, this world’s fate had been sealed. Of course, the apocalypse will descend, and for some reason, the universe wants him there.
Not that he would run off when he could stay and see what the apocalypse looks like.
In his defense, he could just kill every last member of the Hand, but he was told that one way or another, the gate of the apocalypse would be opened.
So he wants to handle that first before ascending. His reason is simple: he wants to ensure the world in which his journey began is not destroyed in his absence.
Of course, this also concerns Vexthra. He doesn’t want his wife’s world to be destroyed. Vexthra came from Sonox, so he wants to save it before he leaves.
Kent wanted to get that done first. But the moment that was done and he ascended, he would seek Gorzak’s world and help him get revenge.
For now, though, the Barbarian King could wait. Things were much more complex than they looked.
Valtor, the Panther Assassin, only remembered his time in the Veil of Eternal Damnation. This assassin organization had trained some of the most lethal assassins in the universe’s history.
It was even rumored that the infamous Faceless Assassin was once a member, and as someone who admired the Faceless Assassin, Valtor joined—and that was all he recalled.
However, that was enough for him, as he finally understood why he had become an assassin.
It was to follow in the Faceless Assassin’s footsteps. Kent was rather happy to hear him say that. It turns out that the aloof man he met in his memories had more fans than he let on.
First, it was Sir Ashfur, and now, it is Valtor.

However, Kent had not yet revealed his identity as the Faceless Assassin. He would do that some other time. So for now, they could remain in the dark. He would tell them one of these days... Telling them will be good though..
Especially for someone like Valtor, whom he knew would become much more lively now. His reason for becoming an assassin had been revealed, so he would now become more active...

Irina, the strongest of them all, just recalled killing her entire family because they chose to submit to the same king who killed her brother and took her sister hostage just because she refused to marry him.
Kent expected her to be seething with anger when she spoke, but to his shock, she merely smiled.
When he asked why, Irina casually smiled and answered, "I don’t leave loose ends. Since I took care of my family, I’m certain the other was also taken care of."

When Kent asked what if she failed and that was why she found herself on the last floor of the dungeon she came from, she smiled again and answered, "I don’t fail when it comes to killing... the fact that I am here is probably me being tired of killing and choosing to retire."

If her brothers and sisters were wary of her before, then now they were scared of her. The nonchalant way she spoke said it all; she was confident in her words, and that alone made them recognize why she was the strongest and the most dangerous among them.
Zharkaz, the dragon general, grew more arrogant after remembering some battles he had won. Naturally, this caused his combat strength to rise.
However, aside from that, his bloodline had also awakened, and he could now assume a more refined version of his humanoid form.
They all could do that now. This allowed them to develop a more refined human appearance. Their True Names awakening made them more relatable...
However, Vorthar was still a demon lord and an angry one at that.

It turned out that after years of waging war for his demon king, that bastard had actually been in bed with his wives, and as such, they were the cause of his death, which happened at the hands of ten thousand demons.
Death by a thousand cuts turned out to be much more dubious when ten thousand demons were doing it. His anger was just too deep for Kent to feel.
So he knew waging war on some demons was now on his calendar. If possible, he would also stage a death by a thousand cuts for the said demon king... if he was still alive.
Ankaara already had her memories, so aside from becoming more beautiful and dangerous, the rest of the Eternal Wrath Legion was now having their memories come back to them.
At the moment, they were in fragments...
But one thing was certain—they all wanted revenge, and it would happen...

He would do that some other time.
So for now, they could remain in the dark.
He would tell them one of these days...
Telling them will be good though..
Especially for someone like Valtor, whom he knew would become much more lively now.
His reason for becoming an assassin had been revealed, so he would now become more active...

Irina, the strongest of them all, just recalled killing her entire family because they chose to submit to the same king who killed her brother and took her sister hostage just because she refused to marry him.
Kent expected her to be seething with anger when she spoke, but to his shock, she merely smiled.
When he asked why, Irina casually smiled and answered, "I don’t leave loose ends.
Since I took care of my family, I’m certain the other was also taken care of."

When Kent asked what if she failed and that was why she found herself on the last floor of the dungeon she came from, she smiled again and answered, "I don’t fail when it comes to killing... the fact that I am here is probably me being tired of killing and choosing to retire."
If her brothers and sisters were wary of her before, then now they were scared of her.
The nonchalant way she spoke said it all; she was confident in her words, and that alone made them recognize why she was the strongest and the most dangerous among them.
Zharkaz, the dragon general, grew more arrogant after remembering some battles he had won.
Naturally, this caused his combat strength to rise.
However, aside from that, his bloodline had also awakened, and he could now assume a more refined version of his humanoid form.
They all could do that now.
This allowed them to develop a more refined human appearance.
Their True Names awakening made them more relatable...
However, Vorthar was still a demon lord and an angry one at that.

It turned out that after years of waging war for his demon king, that bastard had actually been in bed with his wives, and as such, they were the cause of his death, which happened at the hands of ten thousand demons.
Death by a thousand cuts turned out to be much more dubious when ten thousand demons were doing it.
His anger was just too deep for Kent to feel.
So he knew waging war on some demons was now on his calendar.
If possible, he would also stage a death by a thousand cuts for the said demon king... if he was still alive.
Ankaara already had her memories, so aside from becoming more beautiful and dangerous, the rest of the Eternal Wrath Legion was now having their memories come back to them.
At the moment, they were in fragments...
But one thing was certain—they all wanted revenge, and it would happen...

chapters.title: Chapter 672: Echoes of the Past [Bonus]
paragraphs: The memory fragments were just too much to take in...
However, while they contained some of the most shocking betrayals, they did yield something: every last one of them became stronger than they were after rising to the Core formation stage.
Of course, their True Name awakening also contributed to the rise in strength. When compared to their past when they were at the Core Formation, their new forms are much stronger...
It showed that the True Name was something they were receiving for the first time, and as such, each became a somewhat better version of themselves. This, of course, was beneficial for them...
Next, Kent focused on his undead.
Kaizo was, as he had heard, a terrifying brute now.
During the Primordial Era, when Chaos went to the Primal Abyss to train, he met Leviathan, one of the Abyssal Leviathans, or at least descendants...

But he was, without a doubt, a Leviathan. Their interaction was brief, but he left an impression on Chaos, and while he didn’t know why he gave him the Primal Bone Tempering Art, Chaos knew he would understand one day.

Kent didn’t have memories from that point yet since he had just started recalling his memories of that life... but during his time, or perhaps long before his time, the Divine Angel Race was the rival of the Abyssal Leviathans.

Some history books referred to them as the First Angels, while others called them the Guardians of the Angels. However, one thing was certain: they were among the most terrifying warriors to have ever lived.
Kaizo had become a force to be reckoned with after awakening the Divine Angel Race Bloodline. If at first he was a brute, now he had become a brute with angelic might.
Kaizo, being Kaizo, decided to show off his new armor, and that was when Kent saw the golden, armless armor covering the brute, one destined to become a mighty figure in the future.
He also had four pairs of metallic angel wings, and his gauntlet was so terrifying that Kent wouldn’t want to be punched by it.

His golden lightning had also become much more dangerous. While Kaizo had yet to reach perfect control over it, he managed to become the third strongest, defeating terrifying brutes like Aetheris and Gorzak.

As for Vaelros, he gained a more powerful form of chains, which he called the Abyssal Chains of Torment. Before his True Name awakening, he was already a powerful brute, but after the awakening, everything about him changed.
First, his bloodline came from the Primordial Era, just like Kaizo. However, unlike Kaizo, who had a known lineage, Vaelros had no known lineage.
The bloodline he awakened was from the Chained Torment... a terrifying beast that was imprisoned in the Chain Isle of Torture by one of the 14 Universe Guardians.
It was strange to awaken something like that... but so far, his bloodline had only awakened 8%. That was pitifully low, but that didn’t mean he had become weaker.

He had become much more dangerous as a result. The only downside now was that Kent didn’t know how to help him awaken more of his bloodline; even the tower didn’t know, but he intended to look for a way out for Vaelros.
The Chained Torment was one of the most dangerous Primordial Beasts to walk the Primordial Era... so one way or another, he would help his Brute Undead unlock more of its powers.
As for the evil demoness, Sylara, Kent suspected she was hiding her powers, fearing that her brothers and sisters would be afraid of her.

This was because her bloodline, like Kaizo’s and Vaelros’s, also came from the Primordial Era. And while Kent didn’t know why she had decided to hide her abilities, he decided to give her the privacy she needed, so he refrained from spying on her using the tower.
But one thing was sure: whatever bloodline she awakened, it was one that even terrified her, and until she became comfortable and opened up, he wouldn’t pressure her or spy on her.
Zareth already had his lineage, and that traced back to the World Serpent...
That left Krex Nithal, the undying Cockroach.
Jacob became a level 5 Core Formation expert after his awakening. Judging by the aura around him, he had become a force to be afraid of.
As for his bloodline, it was from the original Krex Nithal—the one that survived the time of the Sand against all odds and had his revenge on the Sand demons.
As for Yi Lai, formerly known as the Hunter, she had become a dragon, and her class was Dragon Necromancer. This meant she could only have dragon undead in her legion.
She can also modify his dragon and, to some extent, summon dragons too.
She had already become a force to be reckoned with simply because, while Kent expected her to be just a necromancer, she was also a swordsman.
Of course, Kent had no idea she had lived for 50,000 years in her memories, and as a result, when she awakened, those memories came with her.
She emerged as a sword king... and based on Kent’s understanding of the sword path, he recognized two things.

First, Yi Lai was walking a self-created path... just like he did back in the day as Lord Genesis. This meant if she reached the peak one day, she would become the progenitor of the Necrotic Sword Dance Path.
The second thing he noticed was that Yi Lai had a spotless understanding of the sword. She had a solid foundation, and that alone put things into perspective for Kent...
If only he knew Yi Lai was once his disciple of some kind.
She followed him everywhere, and thanks to Kent’s knowledge of the sword path, she managed to walk her own path to the Sword Immortal Stage before she learned to trust Kent.
So she was not only a necromancer with untapped potential, she was also a terrifying swordsman—one who could wield the sword like a true swordsman.
And now that she knew she could rely on Kent, the first thing she did was ask for a favor.
"I want to get revenge on the Oracles."
Kent already expected something like this, so he gave her the go-ahead. He wanted to do it himself, but that would just be a waste when he had terrifying subordinates at his disposal...
Yi Lai thanked him and asked Veera to go with her. This was because while she couldn’t raise the human dead to become her undead, Veera could, and that would add to her strength.
Leaving the bodies behind after her massacre will be a waste...
